mds:icon-picker

A searchable grid of Hugeicons that fills a form field with an icon name.

For the places an app lets people choose an icon — a category, a menu entry, a status. The field holds the icon name, so what comes back is exactly what <mds:icon> takes. Every tile is rendered on the server once and the preview is cloned from it, so no icon source ships to the browser. Live — open it.

Category icon
No icons found.
Shown on the category card. 
<mds:icon-picker
    label="Category icon"
    description="Shown on the category card."
    value="shopping-cart-01"
    name="icon"
    clearable
    class="max-w-xs"
/>

Your own set

Nothing passed means the kit's curated default — Icons::PICKER, 154 everyday icons. Pass :icons with a list of Hugeicons names to offer exactly what makes sense for the field. Icons::names() gives the whole free set when a screen truly needs all 6,200 — a few megabytes of SVG, so keep that to an admin page.

Status icon
No icons found. 
<mds:icon-picker
    label="Status icon"
    :icons="['checkmark-circle-02', 'clock-01', 'alert-02', 'cancel-circle', 'delivery-truck-01', 'package', 'rocket-01', 'fire']"
    :columns="4"
    class="max-w-xs"
/>

Labelled icons

A name => label map labels each tile. The label is the tooltip and the accessible name, and the search matches it as well as the name — the way a Persian user finds an icon.

Menu icon
No icons found. 
<mds:icon-picker
    label="Menu icon"
    :icons="['home-01' => 'Home', 'search-01' => 'Search', 'shopping-cart-01' => 'Cart', 'user' => 'Account', 'settings-02' => 'Settings', 'notification-01' => 'Alerts', 'favourite' => 'Wishlist', 'store-01' => 'Store']"
    value="home-01"
    class="max-w-xs"
/>

Disabled and invalid

disabled makes the whole control inert. An error message, or a validation message under the field's name, marks it invalid.

Disabled
No icons found.
Required
No icons found.
Pick an icon for the category. 
<div class="flex flex-col gap-6">
    <mds:icon-picker label="Disabled" value="package" disabled class="max-w-xs" />
    <mds:icon-picker label="Required" name="icon" error="Pick an icon for the category." class="max-w-xs" />
</div>

In RTL

The built-in strings — the placeholder, the search box, the empty line, clear — follow config('mds.persian_digits'), which is on by default in a real app and off in these docs. Icon names stay LTR inside the field. The grid flows right-to-left and the left/right arrow keys follow the eye.

Reference

mds:icon-picker

PropDescription
valueThe chosen icon name.
iconsA list of Hugeicons names, or a name => label map. Default: Icons::PICKER.
variantIcon style for the tiles and the preview, as on mds:icon.
labelField label.
descriptionSmaller text under the label.
placeholderTrigger text while nothing is picked.
search-placeholderPlaceholder of the search box.
emptyText shown when no icon matches the search.
columnsTiles per row. Default: 8.
clearableAdds a clear button. Default: false.
sizeOptions: sm.
disabledDisables the control.
invalidMarks the control as invalid.
errorError message under the field.
nameField name for a plain form.
wire:modelBinds to a Livewire property.
